name: library-management-system
description: A lending library with catalogue, loans, waiting lists and an audit log. Rebuilt from a C++ console system.
author: Abdul Aakhir Saifullah

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:push && npm run seed
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace client && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace client
